proof_body:
by
  intro R l _ _ _ A
  have key : A ∈ LieAlgebra.Symplectic.sp l R ↔ A.transpose * Matrix.J l R = Matrix.J l R * (-A) := by
    rw [LieAlgebra.Symplectic.sp, mem_skewAdjointMatricesLieSubalgebra, mem_skewAdjointMatricesSubmodule]
    rfl
  rw [key]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b c d, A = Matrix.fromBlocks a b c d := ⟨_, _, _, _, (Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks A).symm⟩
    simp only [Matrix.J, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_neg] at h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, zero_add, add_zero, neg_neg, neg_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_inj] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    refine ⟨a, b, c, ?_, ?_, h1⟩
    · rw [← h2]
    · simpa using h4
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, rfl, hb, hc⟩
    simp [Matrix.J, Matrix.fromBlocks_transpose, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.fromBlocks_neg, hb, hc]
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (l : Type*) [CommRing R] [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l] (A : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) R), A ∈ LieAlgebra.Symplectic.sp l R ↔ ∃ a b c : Matrix l l R, A = Matrix.fromBlocks a b c (-a.transpose) ∧ b.transpose = b ∧ c.transpose = c
